verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents an official CLI at docs.crossplane.io/cli. It covers rendering and testing Composition Functions without a cluster, troubleshooting compositions and managed resources, and building, installing and pushing packages, with version and channel selection via XP_CHANNEL/XP_VERSION. That clearly delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of AI- or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output, scripting guidance for automated workflows), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
